Released SFT evaluator chooses hf_reasoning loader; these CSVs lack explicit user/system columns, so that path uses generic default instructions and omits metadata. This prospective baseline follows the separate released RL prompt, not that SFT path.

interpretation.actually_supplied: Complete sequence, organism, full native InterPro and GO-GPT predicted context, exact released RL prompt/summary-tag instruction. No names, curated GO, teacher trace, expression, structures or PPI.
interpretation.reference_answer_source: Primary native union of curated GO plus predictor go_pred_leaf, dependent on supplied go_pred context; curated-only diagnostic has predictor overlap too, with historical independence unverified. Both references scorer-only.
interpretation.good_score_establishes: Agreement with the frozen augmented target, potentially by recovering/copying supplied predictor GO terms; not isolated novel function inference. Curated-only diagnostic separately measures recorded annotation recovery with declared input overlap.
interpretation.bad_score_establishes: Limited recovery under the chosen full-sequence/context interface; does not isolate reasoning, rule out unannotated functions, or dismiss learned specialist representations.
interpretation.explanation_correctness: Unassessed independently. Correct GO predictions do not validate rationales; missing support does not automatically mean false.
